# One cause not many customers

`customer_support.heu.queue_management.one_cause_not_many_customers` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> When arrivals spike, look for one cause before you assume many customers.


## The heuristic

**When arrivals spike, look for one cause before you assume many customers.**


_Why:_ Independent customers rarely change behaviour simultaneously. A jump in volume is almost always a single upstream event with many downstream reporters, and it is fixable where it started far more cheaply than where it landed.
